# Clipper

`clipper.js` is the unminified `clipper-lib` npm package 6.4.2
(upstream JavaScript version 6.4.2.2), by Angus Johnson and Timo.
Tarball SHA-1: `f2444d87913aaea8312f9e26421b0843f4149e87`.

Only a local `module.exports` object and an ESM default export were added.
The upstream implementation and attribution headers remain unchanged.
There are no runtime package downloads or external script requests.

See LICENSE-clipper.txt (Boost Software License 1.0) and LICENSE-jsbn.txt
(Tom Wu's JSBN license for the embedded integer implementation).
